outline.title: Free Books. Complete Learning Paths.
outline.summary: Cover slide establishing the Finreels blueprint for a legally accessible, non-fiction knowledge base.

outline.title: From a content library to learning infrastructure
outline.summary: Shift focus from popular titles to a structured progression (beginner to professional) that guides learning.

outline.title: One non-negotiable: free must mean legal
outline.summary: Strict requirement for legal, free access through legitimate sources, excluding paywalls and piracy.

outline.title: “Complete” means a pathway, not a pile
outline.summary: Define a complete pathway: foundation, core curriculum, practice, and professional depth.

outline.title: One blueprint across 80 categories + General
outline.summary: Apply the knowledge structure across 80 categories and personal development in the General collection.

outline.title: 500+ is a quality threshold—not a quota
outline.summary: Target 500+ high-quality books per category without lowering standards to reach the number.

outline.title: The research operating system
outline.summary: Six-step process for researching, mapping, verifying, and organizing books by category.

outline.title: A verification gate protects the library
outline.summary: Five criteria for selection: free/legal, real/verifiable, non-fiction/relevant, high quality, and distinct.

outline.title: Organize for action, not just discovery
outline.summary: Sequence resources for learning, tag effectively, and make knowledge gaps visible.

outline.title: Definition of done: category by category
outline.summary: Criteria for completing a category: mapped, verified, deduplicated, and logically organized.

outline.title: Build the most useful free learning library possible
outline.summary: Closing slide emphasizing competence enabled and the next steps for Finreels.
